sections.en: Android TV and Google TV: debloat tools
sections.zh: Android TV 和 Google TV：去广告、精简工具
sections.intro_en: Sony, TCL, Hisense, Philips, Chromecast with Google TV, NVIDIA Shield, onn and other Android-based TVs. Almost all of these switch apps off over Wi-Fi ADB with `pm disable-user`, which a single `pm enable` reverses.
sections.intro_zh: 索尼、TCL、海信、飞利浦、Chromecast with Google TV、NVIDIA Shield、onn 等基于 Android 的电视。几乎都是通过 Wi-Fi ADB 用 `pm disable-user` 停用应用，一条 `pm enable` 就能恢复。

sections.en: Android TV and Google TV: ad-free home screens
sections.zh: Android TV 和 Google TV：无广告桌面
sections.intro_en: Launchers only, without a debloat step. On many Google TVs the stock launcher cannot be fully replaced; these use a Home-button service instead. Do not disable the stock launcher unless the project tells you how to get it back.
sections.intro_zh: 只换桌面，不做精简。很多 Google TV 无法彻底替换原厂桌面，这些项目改用 Home 键服务接管。除非项目写明了恢复方法，否则不要停用原厂桌面。

sections.en: Xiaomi, TCL and other China-market TVs
sections.intro_en: China-market firmware (PatchWall, TCL, Skyworth/Coocaa, Hisense VIDDA) ships more ads and boot-screen promotions, and often lacks Google services. These projects are written for it, mostly in Chinese.
sections.intro_zh: 国行固件（PatchWall、TCL、创维/酷开、海信 VIDDA）开机广告和推荐位更多，通常没有谷歌服务。下面的项目专门针对国行机，大多是中文文档。

sections.intro_en: Fire OS protects Amazon's launcher as a system app, so without root you cannot disable it. These projects redirect the Home button instead, and switch off Amazon's ad and telemetry services.
sections.intro_zh: Fire OS 把亚马逊桌面设为受保护的系统应用，不 root 无法停用。这些项目改为重定向 Home 键，并关掉亚马逊的广告和遥测服务。

sections.intro_en: These install through LG's official Developer Mode. The stock home screen stays; you open the new one as an app or with a Home-button helper. Developer Mode sessions expire and need renewing.
sections.intro_zh: 这些项目通过 LG 官方的开发者模式安装。原厂桌面保留，新桌面作为应用打开，或通过 Home 键辅助程序进入。开发者模式会过期，需要续期。

sections.zh: LG webOS：已 root 的电视
sections.intro_en: Root lets a launcher really take over Home and lets you block LG's ad and ACR (what-you-watch) services. Most current LG firmware is patched against the public exploits, so check your firmware version first.
sections.intro_zh: root 之后，新桌面才能真正接管 Home 键，也能屏蔽 LG 的广告和 ACR（收视识别）服务。目前大部分 LG 新固件已经修补了公开漏洞，先查清楚自己的固件版本。

sections.intro_en: Most launchers install through Tizen Developer Mode. Taking over the Home button means rewriting undocumented settings, so read each project's undo section before you start.
sections.intro_zh: 大部分桌面通过 Tizen 开发者模式安装。接管 Home 键要改写未公开的系统设置，动手前先读每个项目的还原说明。

sections.intro_en: VIDAA is Hisense's own OS (not the Android-based VIDDA sold in China).
sections.intro_zh: VIDAA 是海信自研系统，和国内销售的基于 Android 的 VIDDA 不是一回事。

sections.intro_en: Use with Pi-hole, AdGuard Home or your router. Works on any TV, with no changes on the TV itself; it can also break features, so start with the safe tier.
sections.intro_zh: 配合 Pi-hole、AdGuard Home 或路由器使用。电视本身不用改，任何电视都能用，但可能让某些功能失效，先从温和档开始。

sections.zh: 电视上看 YouTube 不看广告
sections.intro_en: Third-party YouTube clients and SponsorBlock add-ons. Signing in with your Google account is optional in most of them.
sections.intro_zh: 第三方 YouTube 客户端和 SponsorBlock 插件。大部分不登录 Google 账号也能用。

projects.name: CleanYourTV
projects.en: The one that started the wave. A coding agent finds your TV's bloat over Wi-Fi, asks before each change, and installs an Apple TV-style home screen. One-line restore.
projects.zh: 这一波的起点。让编程 Agent 通过 Wi-Fi 找出电视上的预装垃圾，每一步都先问你，再装一个 Apple TV 风格的桌面。一行命令就能还原。

projects.name: Clean Your TV app
projects.en: CleanYourTV as an Android phone app: no laptop and no coding agent. Shows the plan before changing anything.
projects.zh: CleanYourTV 的安卓手机版，不用电脑也不用 Agent。动手前会先列出计划。

projects.name: Tellyscope
projects.en: 3 MB phone app: debloat, install APKs, move files. Every change goes into a history with Undo, plus a full Reset TV. Also Fire TV and Shield.
projects.zh: 3 MB 的手机应用：精简、装 APK、传文件。每次改动都记进历史，可以逐条撤销，也能一键恢复出厂状态。支持 Fire TV 和 Shield。

projects.name: TidyTV
projects.en: Phone app that saves a backup on both TV and phone before switching anything off. "No computer. No AI."
projects.zh: 手机应用，动手前在电视和手机上各存一份备份，再停用应用。主打“不用电脑，不用 AI”。

projects.name: CleanMyTV
projects.en: Free Mac and Windows app built on CleanYourTV's per-TV lists. No Python or `adb` to install, with a user guide and a known-devices table.
projects.zh: 免费的 Mac 和 Windows 应用，用的是 CleanYourTV 的分机型清单。不用装 Python 或 `adb`，附用户指南和已验证机型表。

projects.name: TV Detox
projects.en: Makes an old, slow Android TV fast again: Claude Code or Codex does the work, you press OK on the remote. Covered by Mashable and t3n.
projects.zh: 让老旧卡顿的 Android TV 重新变快：Claude Code 或 Codex 干活，你只需按遥控器的确认键。Mashable、t3n 报道过。

projects.name: tv-home
projects.en: One Claude Code prompt, or scripts by hand. On a 2 GB TCL Google TV it cut home-screen memory from 192 MB to 83 MB.
projects.zh: 一段 Claude Code 提示词，或者手动跑脚本。在一台 2 GB 的 TCL Google TV 上，桌面内存从 192 MB 降到 83 MB。

projects.name: tv (cobanov)
projects.en: A one-page guide and an agent prompt in ten languages. The prompt forbids `pm uninstall`, root and custom ROMs outright.
projects.zh: 一页指南加一段 Agent 提示词，十种语言。提示词明确禁止 `pm uninstall`、root 和刷机。

projects.name: Glass TV
projects.en: Debloat plus a frosted-glass home screen that clears app caches every 15 days, so the TV stays fast.
projects.zh: 精简加毛玻璃桌面，每 15 天自动清一次应用缓存，让电视一直流畅。

projects.name: Android TV Makeover
projects.en: Debloat, an Apple TV-style launcher and a phone remote served by the TV itself. `PROMPT.md` walks a coding agent through it.
projects.zh: 精简、Apple TV 风格桌面，外加一个由电视自己提供的手机遥控网页。`PROMPT.md` 带着 Agent 一步步做。

projects.name: TV Remote
projects.en: Remote from phone, computer or browser, with an Optimize TV button that Undo fully reverses. Also LG, Samsung, Roku and VIDAA.
projects.zh: 手机、电脑或浏览器都能当遥控器，带一键优化，撤销能完全复原。也支持 LG、三星、Roku 和 VIDAA。

projects.name: Kit TV Android
projects.en: Double-click app for Windows, Mac and Linux, in French and English. Has a Restore everything option.
projects.zh: Windows、Mac、Linux 双击即用，法语和英语文档，有“全部还原”选项。

projects.name: ChistyTV
projects.en: Russian. One PowerShell line or an Android APK, for Yandex TV, Salute TV, Xiaomi, TCL, Haier and Google TV.
projects.zh: 俄语。一行 PowerShell 或一个安卓 APK，支持 Yandex TV、Salute TV、小米、TCL、海尔和 Google TV。

projects.name: Claude TV
projects.en: A native launcher with no Internet permission, plus model-specific debloat lists and restore scripts for Bash and PowerShell. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
projects.zh: 原生桌面，不申请联网权限，附分机型的精简清单和 Bash、PowerShell 还原脚本。与 Anthropic 无关。

projects.name: tv-vibehack
projects.en: Built for aging parents: a direct-boot launcher, and the sponsored Netflix or Prime buttons on the remote remapped to HDMI.
projects.zh: 为家里老人做的：开机直达桌面，遥控器上的 Netflix、Prime 广告键改成切换 HDMI。

projects.name: Android TV Toolkit
projects.en: Desktop GUI for TCL and Google TV debloat and APK installs. The author says it is no longer actively maintained.
projects.zh: 桌面图形界面，针对 TCL 和 Google TV 精简和装 APK。作者说明已不再积极维护。

projects.name: Plume
projects.en: 0.4 MB, glass design, Continue Watching, 250+ aerial screensavers. Takes the Home button on Google TV where the launcher can't be replaced.
projects.zh: 0.4 MB，玻璃风格，有“继续观看”和 250 多段航拍屏保。在无法替换桌面的 Google TV 上也能接管 Home 键。

projects.name: Tigris
projects.en: tvOS 26-style dock, Top Shelf and Control Center. Chinese and English, with a webOS preview build.
projects.zh: tvOS 26 风格的 Dock、Top Shelf 和控制中心。中英双语，还有 webOS 预览版。

projects.name: tvOS Launcher
projects.en: About 30 MB of RAM and no background CPU. Runs CleanYourTV debloat profiles on the TV itself, no PC needed.
projects.zh: 约 30 MB 内存，后台零 CPU。能在电视上直接跑 CleanYourTV 的精简配置，不用电脑。

projects.name: LTvLauncher
projects.en: FLauncher fork for Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV: Continue Watching, input switching, OLED screensaver.
projects.zh: FLauncher 的分支，支持 Android TV、Google TV 和 Fire TV：继续观看、信号源切换、OLED 屏保。

projects.name: couch-tv
projects.en: Home screen and phone remote for Google TV, Samsung and LG, with an optional Claude assistant. Read its 8 November note on restart loops.
projects.zh: Google TV、三星和 LG 的桌面和手机遥控器，可选接入 Claude 助手。注意看它 11 月 8 日关于重启循环的说明。

projects.name: OmarchyTV
projects.en: Omarchy-styled launcher for Android TV, LG and Samsung, with a phone-as-gamepad arcade. Beta.
projects.zh: Omarchy 风格的桌面，支持 Android TV、LG 和三星，手机可当手柄玩小游戏。测试版。

projects.name: Luma
projects.en: Calm, tvOS-inspired home over living wallpapers. `./luma.sh restore` undoes everything the installer changed.
projects.zh: 安静的 tvOS 风格桌面，配动态壁纸。`./luma.sh restore` 能撤销安装时的全部改动。

projects.name: Talkies
projects.en: One screen: your apps, what is trending locally, live cricket and football scores. Install with no computer, a computer, or an AI assistant.
projects.zh: 一屏搞定：你的应用、本地热门内容、板球和足球比分。可以不用电脑装、用电脑装，或交给 AI 助手装。

projects.name: Couchy Launcher
projects.en: One-screen launcher that makes no network requests out of the box. English and Chinese.
projects.zh: 单屏桌面，默认不发任何网络请求。中英双语。

projects.name: Matinee
projects.en: Only the apps you installed, in your order, with your last-played show. Row and grid layouts.
projects.zh: 只显示你装的应用，按你排的顺序，带上次看到的节目。横排和网格两种布局。

projects.name: GlassOS
projects.en: Glassy tvOS-style home with a trending Top Shelf and Control Center. Also on Fire TV.
projects.zh: 玻璃质感的 tvOS 风格桌面，有热门 Top Shelf 和控制中心。也支持 Fire TV。

projects.name: Aura
projects.en: Installs from the TV with a Downloader code. 60 fps on a 1.5 GB TV.
projects.zh: 在电视上输入 Downloader 代码就能装。1.5 GB 内存的电视也能跑 60 帧。

projects.name: Glassio
projects.en: Apple TV-style home fed by Nuvio and Stremio catalogs, with Trakt and Simkl Continue Watching.
projects.zh: Apple TV 风格桌面，内容来自 Nuvio 和 Stremio 目录，支持 Trakt、Simkl 的继续观看。

projects.name: Material TV Launcher
projects.en: Material 3 launcher that orders apps by use. Optional Gemini voice with your own key.
projects.zh: Material 3 风格，按使用频率排序应用。可用自己的密钥接 Gemini 语音。

projects.name: TV Launcher
projects.en: Early-stage launcher for big screens, from a Jellyfin Android TV developer.
projects.zh: 早期阶段的大屏桌面，作者是 Jellyfin Android TV 的开发者。

projects.name: Aerial
projects.en: The biggest Chinese one. tvOS-style launcher for Xiaomi, TCL, Skyworth and Sony sets, boxes and projectors; survives standby cleanup. Works with Chinese agents (Doubao, Qwen, Trae) too.
projects.zh: 中文圈最火的一个。参照 tvOS 的桌面，适配小米、TCL、创维、索尼电视，也能装在盒子和投影仪上，待机不会被清理。豆包、千问、Trae 等国产 Agent 也能装。

projects.name: tv-fresh
projects.en: Xiaomi MIUI TV guide and agent skill: remove ads and preinstalls, switch to Projectivy. Uses `pm uninstall --user 0`, reversible with `install-existing`.
projects.zh: 小米电视（MIUI TV）攻略加 Agent 技能：去广告、清预装、换 Projectivy 桌面。用 `pm uninstall --user 0`，可用 `install-existing` 还原。

projects.name: Android TV 调优工具箱
projects.en: Brand-by-brand ADB playbook for TCL, Xiaomi, Hisense, Skyworth, Changhong, Konka, XGIMI and Dangbei. Snapshot, one change at a time, `restore-all`.
projects.zh: 分品牌的 ADB 调试流程，覆盖 TCL、小米、海信、创维、长虹、康佳、极米、当贝。先快照，一次改一条，`restore-all` 一键回滚。

projects.name: Quiet TV
projects.en: Lightweight launcher and app manager for China-market TVs, with reversible slimming and a per-model test log.
projects.zh: 面向国产电视的轻量桌面和应用管理，可恢复的精简，附机型验证记录。

projects.name: 归藏电视
projects.en: Clean Xiaomi TV launcher with large text and direct HDMI shortcuts to consoles and Apple TV.
projects.zh: 给小米电视做的简洁桌面，大字号，一键直达游戏机和 Apple TV 的 HDMI 入口。

projects.name: tvhome-zh
projects.en: Ready-to-install Chinese build of the CleanYourTV launcher. No build step.
projects.zh: CleanYourTV 桌面的中文现成安装包，不用自己编译。

projects.name: GlassTV 玻璃桌面
projects.en: Glass launcher with flip-clock screensaver. Disables no system apps at all.
projects.zh: 玻璃桌面加翻页时钟屏保，完全不停用系统应用。

projects.name: miTVhosts
projects.en: Hosts file for a Xiaomi router that blocks Mi TV ads and updates. Old (last change 2024) but still referenced.
projects.zh: 用于小米路由器的 hosts，屏蔽小米电视广告和升级。较老（2024 年后未更新），仍常被引用。

projects.name: dumbtv
projects.en: Takes ads, tracking and clutter out of a Fire TV over ADB and keeps your apps and HDMI inputs. One command undoes it.
projects.zh: 通过 ADB 去掉 Fire TV 的广告、追踪和杂乱内容，保留你的应用和 HDMI 输入。一条命令就能撤销。

projects.name: Homestead
projects.en: Replacement home and Home button for Fire TV. An on-device ADB tunnel means no computer is needed.
projects.zh: Fire TV 的替代桌面，同时接管 Home 键。用电视自带的 ADB 通道，不需要电脑。

projects.name: FireFrame
projects.en: Your apps, a photo and the time, plus one undoable script that turns off Amazon ads, tracking, Alexa and Prime Video.
projects.zh: 只有你的应用、一张照片和时间，再加一个可撤销的脚本，关掉亚马逊广告、追踪、Alexa 和 Prime Video。

projects.name: Home on Fire
projects.en: Redirects the Home button to the launcher you choose, and opens it at boot.
projects.zh: 把 Home 键重定向到你选的桌面，开机直接进入。

projects.name: Firestick Cleanup
projects.en: Installs Projectivy Launcher and disables Amazon bloat in one automated run.
projects.zh: 一次自动装好 Projectivy 桌面并停用亚马逊预装。

projects.name: Free My TV
projects.en: Fast, ad-free home for Google TV, LG and Samsung, built with Claude Code. Nothing uninstalled; one button brings the factory home back.
projects.zh: 用 Claude Code 做的快速无广告桌面，支持 Google TV、LG 和三星。不卸载任何东西，一个按钮恢复原厂桌面。

projects.name: Clean Your TV for webOS
projects.en: Personal home with your apps and a dock, plus an on-TV Home helper. It says plainly that it does not remove ads from LG's other screens.
projects.zh: 自定义桌面加 Dock，带电视端 Home 键辅助。它明确说明不会去掉 LG 其他界面里的广告。

projects.name: Free My TV for webOS
projects.en: 60 fps frosted-glass shelf with live weather on unrooted LG TVs. English and Portuguese.
projects.zh: 未 root 的 LG 电视上也能跑 60 帧的毛玻璃应用栏，带实时天气。英语和葡萄牙语。

projects.name: webos-vibehack
projects.en: webOS port of the Apple TV-style launcher, tested on an LG OLED C6 (webOS 26).
projects.zh: Apple TV 风格桌面的 webOS 移植版，在 LG OLED C6（webOS 26）上测试过。

projects.name: Hearth
projects.en: Calm home for webOS 3 to 26. Works as a normal app; on a rooted TV it can also be the boot screen and the Home button.
projects.zh: 适用 webOS 3 到 26 的安静桌面。平时作为普通应用运行；在已 root 的电视上还能作为开机界面并接管 Home 键。

projects.name: TheBoringTV
projects.en: Google TV-style home as a plain HTML/JS app, no build step. Becomes the real home on rooted TVs.
projects.zh: Google TV 风格桌面，纯 HTML/JS，不用构建。在已 root 的电视上能成为真正的桌面。

projects.name: Mi pantalla
projects.en: Spanish. Liquid-glass launcher for webOS 5 without root, with a reproducible tutorial and an agent bridge.
projects.zh: 西班牙语。webOS 5 不 root 也能用的液态玻璃桌面，附可复现教程和 Agent 接入。

projects.name: Homebrew Channel
projects.en: The unofficial webOS app store and root tooling that most rooted-TV projects below build on.
projects.zh: 非官方 webOS 应用商店和 root 工具，下面大多数 root 项目都基于它。

projects.name: faultmanager-autoroot
projects.en: Roots webOS 4.0+ TVs and installs the Homebrew Channel. Check the supported-firmware notes first.
projects.zh: root webOS 4.0 以上的电视并装好 Homebrew Channel。先看支持的固件说明。

projects.name: dejavuln-autoroot
projects.en: Roots webOS 3.5+ TVs. 2024 models and recent firmware for most webOS 5+ TVs are patched.
projects.zh: root webOS 3.5 以上的电视。2024 款机型和大部分 webOS 5 以上机型的新固件已经修补。

projects.name: RootMyTV
projects.en: The classic browser-based root. Patched by LG; unlikely to work on firmware since mid-2022.
projects.zh: 经典的浏览器一键 root。LG 已修补，2022 年年中以后的固件基本用不了。

projects.name: Glasshouse
projects.en: Dashboard, privacy controls, debloat, ad and telemetry blocker and Home Assistant bridge, running on the TV itself.
projects.zh: 跑在电视上的控制面板：隐私开关、精简、广告和遥测屏蔽，还能接 Home Assistant。

projects.name: CleanYourTV for webOS
projects.en: Takes over Home with a RAM-only mount, so a reboot without it restores LG's own home. Optional ad and telemetry debloat.
projects.zh: 用只存在于内存的挂载接管 Home 键，重启后不启用它就回到 LG 原厂桌面。可选去广告和遥测。

projects.name: own-your-glass
projects.en: Hardening: disables the microphones and the remote's voice pipeline, plugs the screen-capture leak, blocks ad, telemetry and ACR endpoints.
projects.zh: 安全加固：关闭麦克风和遥控器语音链路，堵住屏幕截取泄露，屏蔽广告、遥测和 ACR 地址。

projects.name: Luma for webOS
projects.en: Native Apple TV-inspired launcher for rooted LG TVs.
projects.zh: 已 root 的 LG 电视用的原生 Apple TV 风格桌面。

projects.name: Lumen
projects.en: tvOS-style home tuned for weak TV GPUs, tested on a 1.5 GB webOS 22 set.
projects.zh: 针对弱显卡优化的 tvOS 风格桌面，在 1.5 GB 内存的 webOS 22 电视上测试过。

projects.name: Lightkeeper
projects.en: Calm home for older webOS, made to sit beside Glasshouse.
projects.zh: 给老版本 webOS 用的安静桌面，搭配 Glasshouse 使用。

projects.name: Apps2Samsung
projects.en: One-click installer for Tizen TVs, projectors and monitors (Jellyfin, TizenTube and more), from Windows, Mac, Linux, Android or iPhone. No Tizen Studio.
projects.zh: Tizen 电视、投影和显示器的一键安装器（Jellyfin、TizenTube 等），Windows、Mac、Linux、安卓、iPhone 都能用，不需要 Tizen Studio。

projects.name: Vetro
projects.en: Launcher, debloater and remote remapper with a dashboard served by the TV. Needs root; about 24% more free RAM on a Q80A.
projects.zh: 桌面、精简和遥控器改键，由电视自己提供控制面板。需要 root；在 Q80A 上可用内存多了约 24%。

projects.name: Quiet Tizen
projects.en: Agent-readable guide from one Samsung U8000F (Tizen 9): quiet launcher, cleanup planner with generated restore SQL.
projects.zh: 基于一台三星 U8000F（Tizen 9）写的、Agent 能读懂的指南：安静桌面，清理计划会同时生成还原 SQL。

projects.name: Arn0 Launcher
projects.en: Clock, your apps and your consoles, nothing else. Takes Home by rewriting undocumented settings, with a saved baseline to undo.
projects.zh: 只有时钟、应用和游戏机入口。通过改写未公开设置接管 Home 键，会保存原始设置以便还原。

projects.name: Glass Home
projects.en: Apple TV-style home with rotating photos, plus a password-protected site on the TV for adding photos from your phone.
projects.zh: Apple TV 风格桌面，照片轮播，电视上还带一个有密码保护的网页，可以从手机传照片。

projects.name: AeroTizen
projects.en: Favourite apps and HDMI inputs in one place; a CLI installs it from your computer.
projects.zh: 常用应用和 HDMI 输入放在一起，用电脑上的命令行工具安装。

projects.name: TV Home
projects.en: Weather-matched landscapes behind your apps, with a level-by-level table of what each step takes and how to undo it.
projects.zh: 背景随天气变化的风景桌面，附一张表，逐级说明每一步要做什么、怎么撤销。

projects.name: Samsung TV root
projects.en: Working root exploits for a QN90B and a QN90F, built with Codex in a day and in three hours.
projects.zh: QN90B 和 QN90F 的可用 root 漏洞利用，分别用 Codex 花了一天和三小时做出来。

projects.name: TizenBrew Installer
projects.en: Installs TizenBrew and other Tizen apps, with re-signing for Tizen 7+.
projects.zh: 安装 TizenBrew 和其他 Tizen 应用，支持 Tizen 7 以上的重签名。

projects.name: alvidaa
projects.en: Self-installing VIDAA launcher (no root, reversible), plus the first public root path for 2024+ VIDAA firmware.
projects.zh: VIDAA 自安装桌面（不 root、可还原），还有首个公开的 2024 年后 VIDAA 固件 root 方法。

projects.name: Sidee
projects.en: Browser dashboard to add web-app tiles to VIDAA TVs. Starts with a double-click on Windows.
projects.zh: 浏览器面板，给 VIDAA 电视添加网页应用图标。Windows 上双击即可启动。

projects.name: LG TV Blocklist
projects.en: Evidence-annotated DNS list for LG telemetry, ads and phone-home traffic, in safe and strict tiers. CC BY 4.0.
projects.zh: 每条都附证据的 DNS 列表，屏蔽 LG 遥测、广告和回传流量，分温和、严格两档。CC BY 4.0。

projects.name: LG TV Ad Block
projects.en: Raw ad and recommended-content blocklist for webOS, tested on an LG C2 in North America.
projects.zh: webOS 广告和推荐内容屏蔽列表，在北美的 LG C2 上测试。

projects.name: SmartTube
projects.en: The best-known ad-free YouTube for Android TV and Fire TV. Read the maintainer's security notice at the top of its README first: some past builds may have been affected and the signing key was replaced.
projects.zh: 最有名的 Android TV、Fire TV 无广告 YouTube 客户端。安装前先看 README 顶部作者的安全公告：过去有几个版本可能受影响，签名密钥已更换。

projects.name: iSponsorBlockTV
projects.en: Self-hosted: connects to the official YouTube app on your TV and skips sponsor segments, and can mute ads and press Skip Ad for you. Nothing installed on the TV.
projects.zh: 自托管：连接电视上的官方 YouTube 应用，自动跳过赞助片段，还能给广告静音并自动点“跳过广告”。电视上什么都不用装。

projects.name: TizenTube Cobalt
projects.en: Ad blocking and SponsorBlock for Android TV, on Google's Cobalt runtime.
projects.zh: 基于谷歌 Cobalt 运行时，给 Android TV 去广告、加 SponsorBlock。

projects.name: TizenTube
projects.en: Removes ads and adds SponsorBlock on Samsung Tizen TVs, via TizenBrew or standalone.
projects.zh: 三星 Tizen 电视上去广告并加 SponsorBlock，可通过 TizenBrew 或单独安装。

projects.name: YouTube webOS Cobalt AdFree
projects.en: Cobalt-based YouTube for LG webOS with ad blocking and SponsorBlock.
projects.zh: 基于 Cobalt 的 LG webOS 版 YouTube，带去广告和 SponsorBlock。

projects.name: Playlet
projects.en: Unofficial, privacy-focused YouTube client for Roku.
projects.zh: Roku 上的非官方、注重隐私的 YouTube 客户端。

projects.name: Aerial Views
projects.en: Apple TV-style aerial screensaver for Android TV, Google TV, Shield and Fire TV.
projects.zh: Apple TV 风格的航拍屏保，支持 Android TV、Google TV、Shield 和 Fire TV。

projects.name: sky adb
projects.en: Android phone app for Wi-Fi ADB and wireless debugging, with LAN discovery. Chinese.
projects.zh: 安卓手机上的 ADB 管理工具，支持无线调试和局域网自动发现。中文。

projects.name: Awesome Android TV FOSS Apps
projects.en: Open-source apps for Android TV, with remote-support and root markers.
projects.zh: Android TV 开源应用清单，标注了遥控支持和是否需要 root。

projects.name: Awesome webOS
projects.en: Apps, launchers, homebrew repos and rooting tools for webOS, with a safety page.
projects.zh: webOS 应用、桌面、Homebrew 源和 root 工具，附安全须知。

projects.name: Awesome Smart TV
projects.en: For developers building Smart TV apps.
projects.zh: 面向开发智能电视应用的开发者。
